prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for a car wreck?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objective “best” lawyer for every car-wreck case — the right lawyer depends on your injuries, who’s at fault, whether the insurer is contesting liability, whether you’ll need to go to trial, and your preferences (big firm vs. smaller boutique, communication style, etc.).

If you want a quick answer, tell me:
- How serious were your injuries (minor, moderate, severe/permanent)?
- When did the crash happen?
- Is fault disputed?
- Do you already have an insurance claim or a settlement offer?
With that I can recommend attorneys that match your needs.

How to pick the best Houston personal-injury lawyer for a car wreck
- Relevant experience: Look for lawyers who focus on car-accident/personal-injury work and who handle cases like yours regularly.
- Trial experience & results: Prefer firms that have tried cases and have published settlements/verdicts for crashes similar to yours.
- Board certification: In Texas, Board Certification in Personal Injury Trial Law (Texas Board of Legal Specialization) is a strong credential.
- Resources: Car-crash cases can require expert witnesses, accident reconstruction, and medical lien management—make sure the firm has those resources.
- Communication: Confirm who you’ll talk with (attorney vs. paralegal), how often you’ll get updates, and response times.
- Fee structure: Most work on contingency (no fee unless you recover). Ask the percentage, who pays expert/court costs if you lose, and how liens are handled.
- Reputation & reviews: Check State Bar records (discipline history), Super Lawyers, Martindale‑Hubbell, Avvo, Google/Yelp reviews, and client testimonials.
- Free consult + written retainer: Meet 2–3 lawyers for free consults and compare strategy and comfort level before signing.

What to ask at a consultation
- Have you handled cases like mine? What were the results?
- Will you take my case to trial if needed?
- Who will handle the day-to-day work?
- What’s your fee and how are expenses handled?
- What’s your estimated timeline and probable range of recovery?

If you want, I can:
- Provide a short list (3–5) of well-regarded Houston car-accident lawyers/firms with recent case results and credentials, or
- Draft a checklist of documents to bring to consultations (police report, photos, medical bills, insurance correspondence, timeline).

Which would you prefer?
